name: APA Reference List Generator

description: A Python scraper for collecting Douyin trending topic data for academic research. Scrapes the hot search list and videos posted under specific trending topics.

name: Quantitative Analysis
description: End-to-end interactive inferential statistics for survey and tabular data. Guides through data cleaning, variable encoding, hypothesis tests, regression modelling, and Excel export — with user confirmation at every decision point.
author: @xjin6

name: Structural Equation Modeling
description: A step-by-step SEM assistant for communication researchers. Covers EFA, CFA, full latent variable SEM, mediation, and moderation analysis using Python. Produces APA-style tables, static AMOS-style path diagrams, and an interactive HTML viewer.
author: @xjin6
